Practically insoluble in water; very soluble in alcohol; slightly soluble in hexane. Profile Moxidectin is an anthelmintic used in veterinary medicine. It is also used as a systemic veterinary ectoparasiticide and is under investigation for the treatment of human onchocerciasis. ◊ References. 1. Cotreau MM, et al. The antiparasitic moxidectin: safety, tolera- bility, and pharmacokinetics in humans. J Clin Pharmacol 2003; 43: 1108–15.
